table.name: TLGNC_PERSON
table.description: Persons known to the Logon system. Not every person needs to be a user of Logon.

column.name: NAME
column.description: Last name/family name of the person.

column.name: FIRSTNAME
column.description: First name/given name of the person.

column.name: MOBILE_NR
column.description: Mobile phone number. For driver-users, this SMS is used to send SMS on 'Release order' and 'Order cancellation' events. For other users: no logic currently, only information.
